pages.text: A dormant knot wants to resume a heartbeat. The Stillness holds it short of that movement. A resonator harvests the tension as Resonance.
pages.title: What remains
Held change
pages.text: Resonance uses the standard FE connection: compatible generators, storage and cables can exchange it directly. It is not another incompatible power network.

pages.title: Held change
pages.text: The Stillness Resonator draws twenty Resonance per tick from sheltered or liberated ground. Nearby resonators within six blocks share that local field. Give them space. Collection is safe and never weakens home’s protection.

pages.title: Refining the sample
pages.text: The Essence Condenser uses one dormant flake and 4000 Resonance to produce one assimilation essence. Processing takes ten seconds when powered. The left slot holds the sample, the right the result. Hoppers can supply raw input and

pages.title: Refining the sample
pages.text: take completed essence.

pages.title: Refining the sample
pages.text: The starter source consumes no ongoing fuel. Its Dormant Knot is part of the crafted instrument. Stored power and paid processing survive saves. A redstone signal pauses generator production.

pages.title: Contained shutters
pages.text: Recover a living Shutter Bloom on an expedition. Build a Bloom Engine around that specimen and a resonator. Its closed chamber supports the specimen even under the Stillness; the contained shutters open while it works.

pages.title: Contained shutters
pages.text: One refined essence sustains thirty seconds of running at eighty Resonance per tick. A full power bank pauses upkeep; an unfed engine goes quiet. Containment does not fail into an unannounced outbreak. Opening the world’s

pages.title: Contained shutters
pages.text: protection remains a separate deliberate act.

pages.title: The severed current
pages.text: A true liberation leaves a stable remnant. Craft an Unattuned Severance Core, then use it on a terminal in a dimension whose bound guardian has been defeated and whose expedition has extracted.

pages.title: The severed current
pages.text: Install the attuned core in a Severance Cradle for 120 Resonance per tick without fuel or field crowding. The source remains tied to that dimension’s proven liberation. Routine completions or a wandering hunting echo cannot grant

pages.title: The severed current
pages.text: it.

pages.title: The severed current
pages.text: The remnant can be carried home or into another frontier. Liberation now provides both an outpost and a practical power source.

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: Sneak-use an attunement sigil on a charged condenser to reverse the Stillness locally. Opening requires a 4000 Resonance reserve; sustaining it consumes twenty per tick. Refining pauses while open.

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: The breach reaches twenty-four blocks. A dormant resonator inside it loses the quiet field it draws from; use a contained bloom engine, a severed core, or power supplied from outside.

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: Close the breach with the sigil or remove its power to restore protection. No source opens a breach automatically. Liberated ground stays silent.
Your discoveries belong to you. A replacement book remembers them.
Place it facing a safe space. Its portal opens above it.
Inspect a sealed sample with use. Sneak-use to draw a fresh, nonlethal sample.
Shapeless. Use the sigil against a terminal; proof is not consumed.
